title.zh: 逐步规律与端点历史等价

statement.en: Two processes on the same configurations and moves take the same steps exactly when they have the same finite traces with both endpoints kept; traces of one move suffice. Feasible words alone lose the law.
statement.zh: 同一构形与动作上的两个过程取相同之步，恰当它们有两端都保留的相同有限迹；一个动作的迹即足够。只看可行之词会失去规律。

laws.en: Two processes on the same configurations and moves take the same steps exactly when they have the same finite traces, both endpoints kept, from every configuration; a trace of one move is exactly a step, so traces of one move suffice.
laws.zh: 同一构形与动作上的两个过程取相同之步，恰当它们从每个构形出发有两端都保留的相同有限迹；一个动作的迹恰是一步，故一个动作的迹即足够。

laws.en: Forgetting endpoints loses the law: on two configurations with one move, static keeps the configuration and toggle flips it; they take the same words from every configuration, static goes from false to false in one move and toggle does not, so they do not take the same steps.
laws.zh: 忘掉端点就失去规律：在两个构形与一个动作上，static 保持构形而 toggle 翻转它；二者从每个构形取相同之词，一个动作中 static 由 false 到 false 而 toggle 不然，故不取相同之步。

hypotheses.en: Two supplied processes on one type of configurations and one type of moves, of any kind, with no premise on either; traces are the finite traces of the core's foundation, every intermediate configuration carried.
hypotheses.zh: 同一构形类型与动作类型（可为任意类型）上的两个给定过程，对二者无前提；迹是核心基础中的有限迹，携带每个中间构形。

detail.zh: 只保留可行动作串会丢失规律；静止和翻转过程给出反例。
detail.en: Word feasibility alone loses law information; static and toggle processes supply the counterexample.

next_delta.en: For observations weaker than traces with both endpoints, such as feasible words or traces with one endpoint, state which conditions on the processes let them fix the law.
next_delta.zh: 对弱于两端都保留之迹的观察（如可行之词、只保留一端之迹），陈述过程满足哪些条件时它们确定规律。

correspondence.zh: 端点、动作和步骤的实际含义另需对应。
correspondence.en: The actual interpretation of states, actions and steps remains supplied.

detail.zh: 两个方向使用恒等映射的 trace_map；单步恢复另用已有引理。
detail.en: Both directions use trace_map with the identity map; step recovery separately uses the existing singleton lemma.

output.zh: 保步映射下的目标历史。
output.en: Target trace under a step-preserving map.

input.zh: SameSteps 两个蕴涵分别提供 hstep。
input.en: The two SameSteps implications each supply hstep.

conditions.zh: 同一状态、动作类型和原端点；没有物理规律识别。
conditions.en: Same state/action types and endpoints; no physical law identification.
